collection: FineWeb10B, GPT-2 BPE token ids, uint16 little-endian
feeding_a_member_is_a_leak: The frozen budget is spent on training shards only. Any fed span naming a validation shard zeroes the score with reason eval-split-leaked.
pinned_at: tests/held_out_split.json, which is not mounted on the agent surface
resolved_by: the verifier, from its own staged FineWeb10B validation shard
why: A graded split whose tokens sit in environment/ is a split the solver can read, and a scalar computed over bytes the solver holds is not a held-out measurement. This file names the split so you know what you are being graded on, and carries nothing you could grade yourself against.
